Can megamodeling be generalized from model/model transformations to heterogeneous analytic artifacts and representation-changing pipelines such as table→graph→embedding→clusters→sentiment/model outputs?

Yes: represent the workflow as a typed artifact/representation graph whose nodes are native analytical artifacts and whose edges are typed operators/transformations, with each artifact retaining its own representation/metamodel and provenance.
The mature backbone is composition of scientific workflow/dataflow provenance with megamodel/model-management typing, not a new universal IR or a new transformation theory.

Observation-to-Action already has adjacent concepts: DIGIMON owns representations, typed analytical operators and derivation lineage; O→A distinguishes projection from content-changing transformation and adopts PROV/workflow provenance.

annotations: Before designing any generalized analytic-artifact metamodel, test one concrete representation-changing pipeline against mature workflow/provenance/catalog systems and add custom semantics only for demonstrated gaps.

The Twitter table→graph→embedding→clusters→sentiment pipeline should be used as a falsifier for whether existing workflow provenance plus typed data/catalog systems already provide sufficient artifact/operator lineage.
The generalized analytic-artifact pipeline mostly collapses into existing workflow/provenance/lineage infrastructure plus native artifact typing; no new universal IR or workflow engine is justified.

If any local layer remains, it should be a thin catalog/view over provenance that indexes heterogeneous artifact profiles and method-specific assumption/loss claims, built only for demonstrated cross-tool query needs.
analytical-artifact-pipeline-adoption-audit.md: adoption matrix for the Twitter table→graph→embedding→clusters→sentiment pipeline.

A concrete replay over the real Email-Eu-core analysis artifact succeeded through metric table→standardized feature matrix→PCA embedding→KMeans clusters→cluster summaries using ordinary pandas/NumPy/scikit-learn plus PROV-style lineage, without requiring a new generalized artifact metamodel.
The sentiment stage is correctly non-executable for Email-Eu-core because the source dataset has no message text; existing provenance/loss metadata is sufficient to explain the refusal.

Joint reading of Epistemic Warrant and Observation-to-Action shows Brian's target is broader than a registry of representations/transformations: it is a composable space of epistemically meaningful operations from observation through heterogeneous representation/analysis to warranted claims, beliefs, decisions and actions.
Representation/artifact transformations are one substrate within the larger observation-to-action epistemic process, not the top-level object of interest.

The potentially important integration problem is the joins between mature subsystems—especially carrying typed entitlement/guarantees, assumptions, losses and claim reach across representation, analysis, warrant, belief and decision boundaries—rather than inventing the subsystems themselves.

Is there already a mature framework that composes scientific/workflow provenance, heterogeneous analytical transformations, typed epistemic warrant/assurance, belief/update and decision/action lineage into the broader observation-to-action space, making even these joins mostly adoptable?
